app_fee.value: The Graduate School requires a fee but the fetched pages do not state its amount.
app_fee.quote: The Graduate School requires a non-refundable application fee paid online by credit card at the time of application submission

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School waives fees only for U.S. citizens and permanent residents; international applicants can ask their program, which may or may not grant one.
fee_waiver.quote: International applicants may contact their respective Program for fee waiver consideration; otherwise, the Graduate School does not supply application fee waivers

gre_general.value: The GRE rule is set by each program; see the program records.
gre_general.quote: Standardized test requirements vary by program, and many programs no longer require the GRE

toefl_min.value: For iBT tests taken after January 21, 2026, the overall minimum is 4 (4.5 for teaching assistantships), with at least 4 in each section.
toefl_min.quote: An overall score of 4 or above (4.5 for teaching assistantship consideration)

ielts_min.value: IELTS minimum is 6.5 overall, with at least 6.5 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: Required minimum score of 6.5, AND minimum scores in the following areas

english_waiver.value: India is not on the Graduate School's exempt list, so a degree from India does not waive the English test; a TOEFL or IELTS score is needed.
english_waiver.quote: A Language Proficiency Exam is not required if an applicant satisfies one or more of these conditions: | A college or university degree earned in the United States or in one of the countries listed above

notes: Checked on the Graduate School admission, international, fee-policy and FAQ pages. The Graduate School does not consider 3-year bachelor's degrees from India to be equivalent to a US four-year degree unless an approved evaluation confirms it (see the international page). Engineering programs (mechanical, civil) use the CAS application with a $65 fee, saved as program overrides.
